concrete_limits: Saved task finished_at and the installed SDK identify task/execution completion, but the saved evidence does not define that field as the final billable resource-release time or bound billable teardown after it. Manifest sandbox_terminated alone is insufficient: SDK terminate defaults wait=False. Later terminal provider metadata is stronger but still lacks the billing endpoint contract.

SandboxList evidence omits actual CPU/memory requests/limits and GPU count; historical runner/source and manifests support intended caps, but the original host runner hash was not captured per run. A provider resource definition or otherwise accepted historical source attribution would close this provenance gap.

Image creation is outside created_at..finished_at. The full original $0.50 allowance and 20% margin are retained, but neither was a provider-enforced maximum; no saved image-build lifetime/resource record proves that $0.50 bounds all pre-creation build costs. This is inherited uncertainty, not evidence the allowance was exceeded.

The rounded resource rates are the existing accepted reservation basis and exceed the saved observed prices; they remain an estimate. No new current rate query was made under this read-only/no-provider task.
recommendation: A manual append-only certificate is algebraically sound and can preserve the original journal. Do not label the $10.50 sum proved or enable its $10.64 release solely from these timestamps. A bounded follow-up should establish the billing endpoint/resource semantics and pre-creation build bound (or explicitly review this as a revision of the same conservative estimate model, rather than provider-proved settlement). Bind each original record once, keep P/A/headroom, require A<=U<=R, never revise the live run, and fail closed on new attributed charges exceeding U.
scope: Read-only completed-run lifetime bound feasibility; current run excluded; no guard/certificate/journal/grant/provider mutation or call.
settlement_distinction: Final settlement is not required if a defensible U bounds all eventual run charges: delayed posting remains covered by U-A and the existing P high-water. The missing item is cost-bound evidence, not a settled watermark.
supported_evidence: Authoritative saved SandboxList supplies per-sandbox created_at, task started_at/finished_at, H200 type and terminal result for all nine mapped runs. All started times are after creation.

Existing manifests bind unique sandbox IDs, one H200, immutable image, timeout and acknowledged termination. Existing overlap certificate pins each manifest plus original guard, worker and uploaded files.

Current runner and Git history since 5b3a180184fce81b1dba702e4a50aa3508205990 use gpu=H200, cpu=(4,4), memory=(32768,32768), no volumes and blocked network. Installed Modal 1.6.3 SDK documents and serializes these tuples as hard request/limit pairs.
Every observed attributed total is below its computed conditional U; this is consistency evidence, not a proof against future corrections.
